sections.heading: Constants
sections.body: Now that you have seen different types of variables in C, you should also know that sometimes you need variables that should not change. This can be done with the const keyword, which makes a variable unchangeable and read-only:

sections.heading: Example
sections.body: You should always declare a variable as const when you have values that are unlikely to change:
sections.code:
const int myNum = 15;  // myNum will always be 15
myNum = 10;  // error: 
  assignment of read-only variable 'myNum'
